notes: DRAFT for C13-F (Jay approved the faith direction in drafts/content/enemies/bestiary-plan.md). Action Zone faith overlay (schoolId action-zone), a swappable layer keyed by faithOverlayKey in drafts/content/bosses/*.json and drafts/content/enemies/guardian-form-shifts.json; core Guardian text stays neutral. Each Guardian drops one relic or scroll, found after it is freed: no locks, no quizzes. One Sensei line per relic that reflects, never lectures. Verse text is KJV, word for word. None of these verses are in docs/faith-and-creed.md (only the motto names Romans 8:37), so each was checked against two public KJV sources on 2026-10-25: bible-api.com (translation=kjv) and bolls.life (KJV). Changes from the plan (Manager notes): Galatians 5:22-23 no longer claims fruit grows slowly; Psalm 23:2 is about rest, not seeing clearly; the Hearth Cook uses John 6:35 instead of Acts 2:46; the Lost Lightbearer adds John 8:12. Jay's calls (PR #229): Hearth Cook keeps John 6:35; Hebrews 13:5 shows only its second half (partial: true); Stone Giant uses 1 Samuel 17:47.

relic.name: Lantern Scroll
relic.description: A hidden scroll in the Lantern Halls, glowing softly.

verses.text: And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.

guardians.sensei: Even a little light is never beaten by the dark.

relic.name: Garden Scroll
relic.description: A scroll under a garden bench, wrapped in a green leaf.

guardians.theme: The good fruit of the Spirit

verses.text: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith, Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.

guardians.sensei: Which of these good fruits did you see today?

relic.name: Bread Scroll
relic.description: A scroll tucked by the supper table, still smelling of warm bread.

verses.text: And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.

guardians.sensei: What fills you up more than supper ever could?

relic.name: Sling Stone
relic.description: A small, smooth stone on the Giant's Steps, wrapped in a tiny scroll.

guardians.theme: David and Goliath, the tier's own form

verses.text: And all this assembly shall know that the LORD saveth not with sword and spear: for the battle is the LORD'S, and he will give you into our hands.

guardians.sensei: David was small, but the battle was the Lord's.

relic.name: Reed Scroll
relic.description: A scroll in the reeds beside the Quiet River.

verses.text: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.

guardians.sensei: Where is your quiet place to rest?

relic.name: Anvil Scroll
relic.description: A scroll on the forge anvil, warm but never hot.

guardians.theme: Courage, because God is with you

verses.text: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.

guardians.sensei: Brave hearts can still feel scared sometimes.

relic.name: Echo Scroll
relic.description: A scroll that echoes back kind words when you open it.

verses.text: I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.

guardians.sensei: Who reminds you that you are never alone?

relic.name: Root Book
relic.description: A book on the Root Library's top shelf, its cover shaped like a leaf.

guardians.theme: A tree planted by the water

verses.text: And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.

guardians.sensei: Strong roots help a tree stand tall.

relic.name: Still Scroll
relic.description: A scroll that stays still in the wind.

verses.text: And he arose, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.

guardians.sensei: Even the wind and waves listened to Jesus.

relic.name: The Last Light
relic.description: The last piece of light, found together at the Summit.

guardians.theme: More than a conqueror; Jesus, the light of the world

verses.text: Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.
Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.

guardians.sensei: The light was with you the whole climb.
